meta.title: Hot Spring County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Hot Spring County's 2026 annual budget as filed with the state, adopted by the quorum court's appropriated transfer ordinance (Bill #25-26). Amounts are the 2026 budget column. The county moves money between its own funds: the General Fund sends $436,404.66 to four other funds and takes in $339,798.21 from four funds (the ordinance lists each transfer), so those dollars can appear in both funds.
